Which of the following is not a 'research purpose'?
The 'demographic transition' is a social trend that involves:

options.A: a reduction in population size, caused by a higher rate of emigration than immigration
options.B: a change in the principal causes of death and disease since industrialization
options.C: increased birth and death rates, resulting in a relatively young population
options.D: a decline in the birth rate, greater life expectancy, and an ageing population

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - a decline in the birth rate, greater life expectancy, and an ageing population

questions.stem_text: The effect of the Internet upon the public sphere has been to:

options.A: repress it, by promoting only the interests of elite groups
options.B: revive it, by reaffirming a commitment to freedom of speech
options.C: reproduce it, by emphasizing face-to-face contact with peer groups
options.D: replace it with a superior form of communication

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - revive it, by reaffirming a commitment to freedom of speech
